description: This file defines a factory function to create CRUD controllers for Mongoose models with tenant enforcement, including utilities for sorting, pagination, caching, and error handling.

methods.name: validateSort
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes a sort string against allowed fields, defaulting to a safe fallback.

methods.name: clampLimit
methods.description: Enforces a maximum limit on pagination size, defaulting to 20 if input is invalid.

methods.name: microGet
methods.description: Retrieves a value from in-memory micro-cache if not expired.

methods.name: microSet
methods.description: Stores a value in in-memory micro-cache with a TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey
methods.description: Constructs a stable cache key for list requests based on request parameters.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant
methods.description: Sanitizes request payloads by removing client-supplied tenant fields and injecting tenantId from request context.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant
methods.description: Merges a filter object with an enforced tenant filter, ignoring client-supplied tenant hints.

methods.name: mapAndReplyError
methods.description: Maps known Mongoose errors to user-friendly HTTP responses.
